headline: DGD windfall drives a blowout profit quarter
summary_short: Darling Ingredients earned $387.3M ($2.41 diluted EPS) in Q2 2026, up sharply from $12.7M ($0.08 EPS) a year ago, as Diamond Green Diesel's equity income swung to $350.0M from $6.0M and combined Adjusted EBITDA rose to $741.7M from $249.5M y/y.
summary_long: Total net sales rose to $1.72B, up 11.2% q/q and 16.4% y/y, with Feed Ingredients the largest contributor (+22.7% y/y). Operating income jumped to $555.2M from $75.9M a year ago, almost entirely reflecting Diamond Green Diesel's equity income swinging to $350.0M from $6.0M as DGD sold 348.8M gallons at $2.23/gal EBITDA. Net income reached $387.3M ($2.41 diluted EPS) versus $12.7M ($0.08) a year ago. The company received $280.0M in DGD cash distributions, repurchased $73.0M of stock, and cut net debt by $223.0M to $3.79B (2.30x leverage); cash rose to $160.7M. For Q3 2026, core ingredients (ex-DGD) Adjusted EBITDA is guided to $325-340M; FY2026 capex estimated at $450.0M and year-end net debt targeted at or below $3B with leverage below 2x.

drivers.explanation: CEO Stuewe credited strong operational execution and margin management for enabling debt paydown, share buybacks and a stronger balance sheet this quarter.
Feed Ingredients net sales rose to $1.15B from $936.5M, the largest contributor to total net sales growth; Food and Fuel Ingredients also grew, per the segment tables.
Feed Ingredients segment gross margin rose to $320.0M from $214.5M, the main contributor to consolidated gross profit growth, per the segment tables.
Nearly all the increase reflects Diamond Green Diesel equity income swinging to $350.0M from $6.0M, per the segment reconciliation; base segment operating income also improved modestly.
EBIT tracks operating income and reflects the same Diamond Green Diesel equity-income swing to $350.0M from $6.0M disclosed in the segment reconciliation.
DGD sold 348.8 million gallons of renewable fuel at $2.23 per gallon EBITDA, driving Darling's share of DGD Adjusted EBITDA to $389.2M from $42.6M a year ago.
Net income growth mirrors the operating income increase from DGD equity income, partly offset by a higher tax provision ($110.6M vs $4.1M) as pretax income rose.
EPS growth mirrors net income's rise since diluted share count was roughly flat (160.6M vs 159.7M shares) year-over-year.
The company received $280.0M in DGD cash distributions during the quarter and repurchased $73.0M of stock, while also cutting net debt by $223.0M.
